'''Wistie Fest pie''' was a [[Pie/Legends|pie]] [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. In order to prepare for the Ewok [[Festival of the Wisties]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], the [[Magic/Legends|wizard]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] gave a list of tasks to the [[Youngling/Legends|young]] Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]]. The last item on the list was to pick a bushel of [[Time/Legends|ripe]] [[Rainbow berry|rainbow berries]] in order to make a large Wistie Fest pie for the festival. The pie was made with a [[Color/Legends|beige]], circular crust, and the [[Berry/Legends|berries]] were turned into a pink filling. During the festival, Wicket's [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Shodu Warrick]], held the pie.<ref name="Fuzzy" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wistie Fest pie appeared in the [[1986]] young readers book [[Fuzzy as an Ewok: Things to See, Touch, and Smell from the Forest Moon of Endor|''Fuzzy as an Ewok'']], which was written by [[Virginia Holt]] and illustrated by [[Deborah Colvin Borgo]].<ref name="Fuzzy" />
